December 12, 2012

Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement

For release at 12:30 p.m. EST

Share

Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in October suggests that economic activity has continued to expand.

The Committee expects low rates at least through mid-2015 and will meet on January 29-30.

Voting for the FOMC monetary policy action were: Ben S. Bernanke, Chairman.

Voting against the action was Jeffrey M. Lacker.

Implementation Note issued December 12, 2012
